name: 全身精铜抽拉冷热龙头款
description: 黄铜机身抽拉多功能出水，陶瓷阀芯冷热调控，电镀工艺持久如新

styleLock.backgroundSystem: flat white #FFFFFF pages alternating with light grey #F4F4F4 panels and deep charcoal #3A3A3A section bands; no textured or photographic backdrops
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light with soft contact shadows on light screens; lower-key directional light inside charcoal bands and pain scenes; 5500K on lifestyle panels
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte stainless-steel sink counter and smooth light stone-look countertop; flat matte graphic surfaces for infographic screens
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, short bold headlines in #3A3A3A (white on charcoal bands) with a small dash-dot divider motif under each headline
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circular outline icons, single uniform stroke weight, black on white; functional diagram colors allowed only inside diagram screens (red #C0392B annotation/hot, blue #3E7BC0 cold, teal #2E9E8F thumbs-up, magenta #C2186B thumbs-down)
styleLock.presentationRules: product centered and stable; scene shots at slight low eye-level, infographic screens straight-on flat; macro details shallow DOF; diagrams always line-drawing style, never photorealistic; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
noDrift: no functional diagram colors used outside diagram screens
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent minimalist monochrome home-improvement ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white background #FFFFFF, light grey panel #F4F4F4, deep charcoal #3A3A3A headlines and section bands, matte black product tone #1A1A1A as visual anchor; neutral temperature; modern geometric sans-serif type only; complete balanced layouts with natural breathing margins, thin-line circular icons and small dash-dot divider motifs; bright even studio lighting with soft contact shadows on light screens and lower-key directional lighting on charcoal bands; stable centered product presentation, functional diagram colors (red #C0392B annotation/hot, blue #3E7BC0 cold, teal #2E9E8F thumbs-up, magenta #C2186B thumbs-down) allowed only inside diagram screens; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 首屏一秒传达“可抽拉、清洗不受限”的核心卖点，赢得点击与停留。
shots.camera: slight low-angle scene view, gooseneck arc rising full height, full product visible
shots.lighting: soft daylight from the left at 5500K, gentle contact shadow at the faucet base
shots.background: clean white wall #FFFFFF with one light grey panel #F4F4F4, matte stainless-steel sink counter
shots.props: stainless sink basin, running water stream, generic hand pulling the spray head
shots.textZone: 右上方主标题横带承载主标题，下方一行短副标
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle hero scene for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. E-commerce first-screen hero: {product} installed on a matte stainless-steel sink, photographed from a slight low angle, its gooseneck arc rising through the frame, a generic hand gently pulling the spray head outward with a clear steady water stream falling into the basin. Soft daylight from the left at 5500K, gentle contact shadow at the base. Background: clean white wall #FFFFFF with one light grey panel #F4F4F4. {product} fills 50-60% of the frame as the anchor, the upper-right headline field completing one balanced composition. Upper-right headline 「{callout_1}」 in #3A3A3A with one short subtitle line. Commercial e-commerce quality, 2K, vertical 2:3. Negative: no brand logo, no watermark, no garbled text, no extra or fused fingers, no distorted faucet silhouette, no cluttered props, no cut-off faucet edges.

shots.intent: 一屏总览六大核心卖点，快速建立“功能齐全”的整体认知。
shots.camera: flat straight-on symmetric 2x3 icon grid, no product photo
shots.props: six thin-line circular outline icons, single uniform black stroke
shots.textZone: 每个图标正下方一行短标签
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic feature-icon wall for {product}. {product_identity_lock} applies to any product depiction. {style_lock}. Flat straight-on layout, no product photo: six thin-line circular outline icons arranged in a symmetric 2x3 grid on pure white #FFFFFF, single uniform black stroke, each icon followed by one short label reading 「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」「{selling_point_4}」「{selling_point_5}」「{selling_point_6}」 in #3A3A3A below. Even flat high-key shadowless lighting. Product occupies 0% (icon-only screen); grid and labels together fill 55-60% of the frame as one centered balanced wall with even panel margins. Clean minimal layout with short readable labels, no dense body text. Negative: no product photo, no brand logo, no watermark, no garbled characters, no 3D or filled icons, no colored icon strokes, no decorative background patterns.

provenance.notes: 11 张详情页切片（800x1200，60px 重叠）拼合提炼。已剥离：源图 LOGO 位、会员二维码浮标、“质保十年”“48小时盐雾测试”“8um 镀层”等具体承诺与数据（一律改为 {selling_point}/{callout} 文案槽位由使用方填写），未抄任何原文案。源文件夹名为“家装家具家用品”，图内实物为哑光黑抽拉式冷热龙头（鹅颈抽拉两用造型，文案偏浴室受益场景），按 taxonomy 归入 家装灯具/厨卫（水龙头属厨卫而非五金，与库内铰链/卸扣/柜脚/电钻等五金模版 id 天然可区分）。冷热红蓝、红圈标注、赞成/反对徽章色仅作为功能性图示色锁进 styleLock。
